HERITAGE_ROWS.title: Six centuries of the Ahom kingdom
HERITAGE_ROWS.body: The Ahom dynasty ruled the Brahmaputra heartland for six centuries. Its capital Sivasagar still holds Rang Ghar, Talatal Ghar, the Joysagar tank and the Shiva dol.

HERITAGE_ROWS.title: The sattras of Majuli
HERITAGE_ROWS.body: Monastic homes of the Brahmaputra islands where Sattriya dance and ritual music still live — the legacy of 15th-century saint-scholar Srimanta Sankardev.

HERITAGE_ROWS.title: Kamakhya Devi
HERITAGE_ROWS.body: The temple of Kamakhya atop Nilachal Hill — one of the oldest Shakti shrines of India.

HERITAGE_ROWS.title: Where faiths meet, where silk is woven
HERITAGE_ROWS.body: The holy town of Hajo where faiths meet, and nearby Sualkuchi — the muga-silk village on the Brahmaputra.

FESTIVAL_STRIP.name: Bihu dance
FESTIVAL_STRIP.about: Dhol, pepa and gagana set the pace — the spring-time dance of the Assamese people.

FESTIVAL_STRIP.name: Ali-Aye-Ligang · Mising
FESTIVAL_STRIP.about: The Mising community's spring festival — dancing to Oinitom songs.

FESTIVAL_STRIP.name: Sattriya
FESTIVAL_STRIP.about: One of the eight classical dances of India, born in the sattras of Assam.

FESTIVAL_STRIP.name: Ambubachi Mela · Kamakhya
FESTIVAL_STRIP.about: The monsoon festival at Kamakhya Temple on Nilachal Hill.

CRAFT_FEATURES.title: Eri, Muga and Pat
CRAFT_FEATURES.body: Muga silk — treasured since the Ahom era — grows deeper in lustre with every wash. Eri and Pat complete the loom's trinity, woven into gamosa and mekhela sador.

CRAFT_FEATURES.title: Gamosa, Jaapi and bell metal
CRAFT_FEATURES.body: The handwoven gamosa honours guests, the jaapi crowns Bihu dancers, and Sarthebari's bell-metal workers hammer heirlooms for naamghars.

PERFORMANCE_WIDE.title: A stage the whole valley shares
PERFORMANCE_WIDE.body: Bihu drums in spring, Sattriya in the prayer hall, Bhaona under festival lamps — Assam performs its memory.

PERFORMANCE_CARDS.name: Bihu · Dhol · Pepa
PERFORMANCE_CARDS.about: The Bihu ensemble — drum, buffalo-horn pipe and bamboo Jew's harp.

PERFORMANCE_CARDS.name: Sattriya · Khol · Taal
PERFORMANCE_CARDS.about: Sattriya dance and the sattra orchestra behind Borgeet and Bhaona.

PERFORMANCE_CARDS.name: Bhaona · Masks · Ojapali
PERFORMANCE_CARDS.about: Masked Bhaona theatre and narrative Ojapali song-cycles of the naamghars.

CUISINE_BAND.name: The Assamese thali
CUISINE_BAND.about: Rice, dal, khar, tenga and pitika — alkaline beginnings, sour middles.

CUISINE_BAND.name: Pitha & Laru
CUISINE_BAND.about: Til pitha, ghila pitha and narikol laru — rice-flour festival sweets.

CUISINE_BAND.name: Masor tenga · River fish
CUISINE_BAND.about: A light, tangy fish curry; recipes draw their sourness from ingredients such as tomato, lemon or elephant apple.
